clips.title: The story
paras: At the Pools of Arlithrien, the Tourmaline Phial gathers blessed moonwell water for Teldrassil's rituals.

Corithras Moonrage gives the Tourmaline Phial to travelers for rituals that tend the World Tree. Druids in Dolanaar use gemstone vials to collect pure moonwell water across Teldrassil. This phial is meant for the moonwell beside the Pools of Arlithrien, southeast of the road to Darnassus, where hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs are growing more troublesome.
